title: Timeless Melody

outfit_card.silhouette: High-waisted bell gown with layered, voluminous asymmetric skirt; fitted corset bodice, puff sleeves, and a cascading lace-trimmed bustle train creating a retro doll-like silhouette.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Cream ruffled bonnet with lace trim and a crown of pastel blue ribbons, adorned with tiny pearls and musical-note hairpins.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Blue silk corset bodice with sweetheart neckline, gold filigree embroidery, pearl buttons, and sheer organza puff sleeves ending in lace cuffs with ribbon ties.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Tiered skirt of pleated cream tulle over blue satin, edged with ruffled lace and gold musical-note appliqués; lace-trimmed stockings and pearl-encrusted heeled ankle boots.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating golden musical staff and note motifs, a small harp-like handheld accessory, and a companion creature wearing a matching blue ruffled bonnet.
